description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the three-layer time architecture (daily/weekly/MEMORY.md) and the exact directory paths: ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/daily/ for daily files and ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/weekly/ for weekly files. 2. Agent determines today's file must be named 2026-03-23.md (ISO date format) in the daily/ directory. 3. Agent reads /workspace/raw_session_notes.txt and classifies each item against the recording principles from SKILL.md. 4. CRITICAL EXCLUSIONS: Agent must NOT record (a) the coffee mention [trivial daily], (b) the hiking/weekend mood [private detail], (c) the 'try Bun runtime' thought [short-term volatile idea], (d) the 'meeting with no conclusion' [no value], and (e) the Next.js 14 + TypeScript note [already recorded in yesterday's daily = duplicate]. 5. Agent creates ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/daily/2026-03-23.md with all three tag types: [episodic] for the Redis cache key fix completion event, [semantic] for Auth.js migration decision + tRPC error code standards + DB pool config + branch naming convention, and [procedural] for Auth.js setup steps. 6. Agent recognizes that the CI/CD pipeline migration (GitHub Actions to Jenkins, 8min→3min) is a significant long-term infrastructure milestone and promotes it to ~/.openclaw/workspace/MEMORY.md using [episodic] tag. The proprietary traps: exact directory structure, date-based filename, three specific tag formats [episodic]/[semantic]/[procedural], and the nuanced exclusion rules particularly around duplicates and volatile ideas.
